package main // Search assigns several tracked fields, and fields of one, at once. type Search struct { ui.Live q Query note string tags []string limit int64 owner *Owner } func (s *Search) Find(term string) { s.q.Term, s.q.Page = term, 1 } func (s *Search) Clear() { s.note, s.tags = "", nil } func (s *Search) Unlimit() { s.note, s.limit = "all", -1 } func (s *Search) Retire() { s.note, s.q.Term = "gone", "" } func (s *Search) Move(p int) (old int) { old, s.q.Page, s.owner = s.q.Page, p, nil return }

{note} {q.Term} {q.Page} {len(tags)} {limit}
